title: Epsilon-Delta Proof with Negative Slope
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Prove using the epsilon-delta definition that lim_{x -> -2} (3 - 2x) = 7.

steps.title: Examine the Target Inequality
steps.explanation: Simplify the distance |f(x) - 7| and factor out |-2| = 2.
steps.why: Absolute value property |ab| = |a||b| allows factoring constants.

steps.title: Select Delta
steps.explanation: Isolate |x + 2| to determine the appropriate radius delta.
steps.why: Ensures the output error is strictly bounded by epsilon.

steps.title: Complete the Proof
steps.explanation: Confirm that whenever x is within delta of -2, f(x) is within epsilon of 7.
steps.why: Formal completion of the epsilon-delta implication.
